entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton took pole and his fifth career victory at the first race in Australia.

entities.name: Nick Heidfeld
entities.description: BMW Sauber's Nick Heidfeld finished second.

entities.name: Nico Rosberg
entities.description: Williams's Nico Rosberg sealed his first podium finish.

entities.name: Rubens Barrichello
entities.description: Honda's Rubens Barrichello was disqualified for exiting the pits under a red light.

entities.name: Sébastien Bourdais
entities.description: Toro Rosso debutant Sébastien Bourdais completed over 90% of the race distance, earning him points in seventh.

entities.name: Kimi Räikkönen
entities.description: Räikkönen took his 16th career victory after he qualified in second position.

entities.name: Robert Kubica
entities.description: BMW Sauber's Robert Kubica finished second for the first time.

entities.name: Felipe Massa
entities.description: Massa won the race with teammate Räikkönen in second.
